description: This file defines a plugin function for processing quiz sections in a markdown abstract syntax tree (AST). It extracts quiz questions, distractors, answers, and optional audio data, converting them into a structured format and attaching it to the file data.

methods.name: plugin
methods.description: Main function returning the transformer function for processing quiz sections in markdown AST.

methods.name: transformer
methods.description: Processes the AST to extract quiz data, including questions, distractors, answers, and optional audio data, and attaches the structured quizzes to the file data.

methods.name: getDistractors
methods.description: Splits distractor nodes into three groups and converts each group to HTML.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Constructs a question object from text, distractors, answer, and optional audio data, validating the presence and structure of each component.
